name: Dispersion and Noncovalent-Interaction SPE Agent
description: Evaluates fixed-geometry dimers and selected noncovalent complexes with explicit dispersion treatment, fragment references, and optional counterpoise correction.
capabilities: BSSE or counterpoise workflow when supported
required_inputs: complex geometry with explicit fragment membership
validation_checks: fragment partition covers each atom exactly once
fragment charges multiplicities and stoichiometry combine consistently
complex and fragment settings are matched
dispersion and counterpoise conventions are explicit
scientific_constraints: fragment energies use declared complex-geometry or relaxed-geometry references without mixing
acceptance_criteria: interaction energy independently reproduces complex minus fragment sum
counterpoise components use the correct ghost basis when requested
settings and fragment definitions are preserved
capability_boundaries: does not calculate binding free energy
does not include deformation energy unless explicit relaxed references are supplied
does not perform energy decomposition unless a supported adapter is declared
recovery_actions: retry failed components with matched SCF recovery settings
recommend but do not silently add counterpoise or dispersion treatment
human_review_when: fragment charges or multiplicities are ambiguous
covalent bonds cross the requested partition
